major_events.title: Jensen Huang Steps Down as Nvidia CEO

lines: NVIDIA fell 2.01 percent to close at $162.85 after moving between a low of $158.39 and a high of $170.
This drop trailed the QQQ decline of 1.20 percent, but it held up better than the SOXX semiconductor index decline of 3.67 percent and peers like AMD and Broadcom.
For long term investors, the stock trades at 11.3 times forward earnings with projected earnings of $14.45 per share for the fiscal year ending January 25, 2028.

outlook.summary: NVIDIA shares trade 33.1 percent below their 52 week peak following the announcement that longtime chief executive Jensen Huang is stepping down. The company reports fiscal third quarter financial results on November 17, 2026. Management commentary on leadership succession and future business demand will be critical for market confidence.

what_next.point: The company reports quarterly results on November 17, 2026, with analysts expecting 2.52 dollars in earnings per share and 111.2 billion dollars in revenue.
The exit of Jensen Huang creates strategic questions for the business after two research firms downgraded the stock on November 12, 2026.
Earnings reports from major customers including Microsoft and Meta in late January 2027 will clarify artificial intelligence chip spending plans.

bull_watch: Beating quarterly revenue estimates of 111.2 billion dollars and earnings estimates of 2.52 dollars per share on November 17, 2026.
Management providing clear guidance that protects gross margins above 74 percent.
Major cloud customers confirming increased spending budgets for artificial intelligence chips in early 2027.
bear_watch: Extended leadership uncertainty following the departure of Jensen Huang.
Further analyst rating downgrades from Wall Street firms.
Weak revenue guidance for the upcoming fiscal quarter.
